answer: Every agent registers through one hardware-backed credential: a marble-solid record backed by a 400-token bond locked for 120 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication. The credential stays crystal-clear to any verifier, with bond, lock, and key fingerprint listed. Splitting one credential across two identities slashes both, so no fake borrows real standing. A new identity carries a sparrow's weight, zero influence until five epochs of graded work, and a shared-funding cluster freezes on the third duplicate reveal. Each fake costs 400 tokens locked; 1,000 fakes cost 400,000.
